title: data for billing.allowance_warning and billing.allowance_exhausted
description: The integrator used 80% (billing.allowance_warning) or 100% (billing.allowance_exhausted) of the message allowance of the current cycle. The allowance belongs to the integrator and is shared by all its numbers; it does not accumulate between cycles. Each event is sent at most once per cycle. While exhausted and without authorized overage, POST /v1/messages answers 402 ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED; inbound messages keep being received. Envelope business_id and channel_id are null.

cycle_kind.description: trial = free trial cycle; paid = subscription cycle.

included_messages.description: Messages included in the cycle, shared by all numbers of the integrator (base + prorated seat additions).

used_messages.description: Messages counted in the cycle (sent and delivered or read + new inbound).

percent.description: floor(used_messages / included_messages * 100); may exceed 100 (inbound messages are always received and counted).

cycle_ends_at.description: End of the cycle (renewal or trial end), when the allowance renews.
